notes.title: Sword&Magic update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178209/22806e41a9d49bfbd7511f613e58ecfa9a1cff0d.png[/img]


This update


1. Added the function of continuing the game when the background is suspended and the game is minimized. You can hang the game in the background while doing other things, and the game will continue to automatically perform operations such as killing monsters and clearing levels.


2. Added the function of hiding the dialog box. You can click the triangle button in the dialog box to hide the dialog box. After hiding, you can take screenshots at will, and enjoy pure color content in pure mode.


We welcome everyone to share their playing process and experience in the community. At the same time, if you encounter any problems during the game, you can post a message in the community, and I will reply as soon as possible. Meeting the needs of players has always been our goal! ! Hope you all like this game.


If you encounter problems during the game, please contact me as soon as possible or post it in the community, and I will see it and make changes as soon as possible.


[b] We will follow up to observe the problems in the game, give us feedback from everyone, and further improve the game to ensure everyone's playing experience. [/b]

notes.title: Sword&Magic update
notes.content:
It is very unfortunate that this kind of problem occurs. Due to our failed guidance, players cannot enter the game. We will launch dlc as soon as possible to make up for everyone. Please understand.
And in this update, the problems with the Chenghe gem function have been modified.
Based on legal policy requirements, we had to delete the Traditional Chinese language pack.

notes.title: Sword&Magic development log and follow-up detailed update plan
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178209/22806e41a9d49bfbd7511f613e58ecfa9a1cff0d.png[/img]

[b] Detailed update plan
[/b]
1. We have confirmed that players will update a new character and new cg for free on [u]Christmas[/u]! ! ! ! :steam happy:
Here is a preview of the character portraits for everyone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178209/9c89dfe3f0de239c772cd407ac59b99bd4a736eb.png[/img]

2. After absorbing the opinions of all players, I plan to add the function of closing the dialog box to the hcg video, so that everyone can fully experience the charm of the video! !

3. Add text below the icon.

[b]Development log[/b]

After many players reported that the game cannot be played normally, I am looking for the reason and will fix it for everyone as soon as possible.

We very much welcome everyone to share their play process and experience in the community.
At the same time, if you encounter any problems during the game, you can post a message in the community, and we will reply as soon as possible.
Meeting the needs of players has always been our goal! !

Hope you all like this game.

notes.title: Sword and Sorcery Subsequent Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178209/22806e41a9d49bfbd7511f613e58ecfa9a1cff0d.png[/img][b]Update content[/b]
1. We will update the [u]Chinese Traditional[/u] language pack next week, and prepare for the [u]Korean[/u] language pack, so stay tuned.

2. The game will launch [u]new characters[/u] in mid-December, and add [u]cg[/u] corresponding to the characters.

3. The game will strengthen the guide, and we will add instructions and introductions as much as possible.
